I can’t continue working in the background or send results later unless a real automation/reminder is created through an available tool (which I don’t have active right now). I can’t monitor or send follow-ups outside this session.

Options I can do right now — pick one:
1) Do the research now and deliver the results in this chat. Tell me the topic, scope, deadline (e.g., “by 5 PM today”), format (summary, bullet points, full report), and any preferred sources or restrictions. I’ll run it immediately and finish in this turn.
2) I can draft an email or calendar reminder you can schedule yourself (or paste into your calendar). Tell me the recipient(s), subject, time to send/remind, and the research brief you want included; I’ll create the text and scheduling instructions.
3) If you have a connected calendar/email automation and want me to schedule/send on your behalf, confirm you want me to do that and give exact details (title, attendees, time, message). I’ll ask for any required confirmation before taking destructive or externally visible actions.

What would you like me to do now? If option 1, please give the research topic and preferred details.
